attempts.summary: Isolated node2 and node3 from exchanging traffic directly on the shared 10.100.54.0/24 segment, while both retain reachability to node1. Root cause of node1's missing address on the segment was diagnosed (stale build-time DHCP lease on eth0 causing dhclient's non-blocking mode to apply a wrong cached IP; docker0's leftover 240.127.1.1/24 was also cleaned per SONiC guidance) and fixed by clearing the stale lease and forcing a fresh DHCPDISCOVER, which correctly obtained 10.100.54.10 from the real network DHCP server — persistent across reboot. Isolation between node2 and node3 was implemented via permanent firewalld rich rules (drop by source/destination address of the peer) on each host, verified via ICMP and TCP. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (SONiC node1 first, waited for full recovery, then node2, then node3), with boot_id changes proving each restart, and full re-verification of connectivity/isolation after each.
